purpose: Teach: コム/ヲタ/お稽古/絢爛/斬る/食い物/大海/面子

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがITコム、つまり「.com」の歴史を解説して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is going to explain the history of the .com era to us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Light pride in her husband's enthusiasm. Unhurried pacing, clear articulation. The tone of someone sharing a gentle family moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「ヲタも個性」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that being an otaku is just part of who you are.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. Direct eye contact with his mother. Slight pause before 'otaku' — testing the word, finding it safe. Quiet certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが私のお稽古事を応援して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is so supportive of my classes.
lines.style: Tender gratitude, slightly private. Speaking more to herself than to him. Gentle trailing-off. The voice of someone noticing kindness that didn't need to be asked for.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと絢爛豪華なお祭りを観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to see the most beautiful festival.
lines.style: Bright, animated recall. Energy lifts on 'festival.' Like he's reliving the colors and sounds. Open, eager — sharing something wonderful he can't quite contain.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが時代劇で悪人を斬る場面を解説して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was explaining the meaning behind that scene in the period drama, the one with the villain.
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful pace. Slightly distant — she's elsewhere in the memory. Careful word choice, as if translating something her husband said into words for her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとおいしい食い物を食べ比べしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had a taste test with all kinds of delicious food.
lines.style: Eager, lively. Bounces slightly on 'taste test.' Quick, bright delivery. The voice of a child who can't wait to tell someone about something fun.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「大海の様な心を持て」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father told me to cultivate a heart as vast as the sea.
lines.style: Gentle, philosophical. Her voice settles on 'sea' — she's carried this with her. Quiet reverence. The tone of someone passing along something wise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに麻雀の面子の集め方を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me how to gather people together for mahjong.
lines.style: Warm, slightly proud. Quickens a bit on the practical details — he's learning something adult. Closes with quiet satisfaction, like he's reached the end of a good story.
